documents_expected.why: award types, required criteria, steps, deadlines and what is not funded

eligibility.rule: Legally registered NGO authorised to work in the project country
eligibility.quote: All applicants must be legally registered, non-government organizations that are authorized to conduct work in the country of the proposed project.

eligibility.rule: Main objective is creating or expanding a protected or conserved area that is not yet protected
eligibility.quote: The primary objective must be the creation/expansion of a protected or conserved area
alt_quotes: The proposed area(s) must be currently unprotected.

eligibility.rule: Area protects CR/EN species, large high-integrity tropical forests or climate-critical habitat
eligibility.quote: Protect globally significant populations of Critically Endangered and Endangered species

eligibility.rule: Support from governments and Indigenous Peoples or local communities, with FPIC
eligibility.quote: The project demonstrates support from relevant governments (including Indigenous governments) and Indigenous Peoples and/or Local Communities, and that relevant Free Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) has been or will be properly conducted.

eligibility.rule: A management system (plan and committee) is or will be in place
eligibility.quote: A management system (management plan and committee) is, or will be, in place that ensures positive and sustained outcomes for the in situ conservation of biodiversity.

eligibility.rule: No fixed-rate overhead, long-term monitoring or research, or large-scale restoration such as tree planting
eligibility.quote: Fixed rate overhead costs, although please note that itemized expenditures will be considered. Long-term ecological monitoring or research. Large scale habitat restoration (e.g., tree planting).

documents.item: Concept note through the online form
documents.quote: Submit a Concept Note through our online form.

effort.step: Submit a concept note (any time; reviewed within 1–2 months)
effort.quote: Concept notes are accepted anytime, and reviewed within 1-2 months.

effort.step: If invited, submit a detailed application in the online portal
effort.quote: If your concept note is successful, you will be contacted by a Rainforest Trust staff member and invited to submit a detailed application via our online portal system.

effort.step: Awards of $250,000 and above: apply by 1 March, 1 July or 1 October; concept note four months before
effort.quote: March 1 • July 1 • October 1 of each calendar year; approved projects are typically funded about 6 months after each application deadline.
alt_quotes: we recommend submitting your Concept Note for review four months in advance of our application deadlines of March 1 • July 1 • October 1.

notes: Two award types: Feasibility Awards (average $10,000) and Protected or Conserved Area Creation Awards (no set maximum). Feasibility awards and creation awards under $250,000 are rolling; larger ones have three yearly deadlines stated without a year, so no due date is set. Land-purchase and community-tenure projects carry extra criteria. The gather's other three documents were a donor FAQ and two privacy policies.
